stem:
Arun splits a bean seed and counts two seed leaves. The plant later has netted veins on its leaves. In class he learns that two seed leaves mark a dicot, one seed leaf marks a monocot, and that dicots often have netted veins while monocots often have parallel veins.

What should he connect?

options.text: Two seed leaves with parallel veins.
Two seed leaves (dicot) with netted leaf veins.
Seed-leaf number with no link to vein pattern.
One seed leaf (monocot) with the bean's netted veins.

teacher.key_rationale: Two seed leaves mark a dicot, and dicots link with netted leaf veins.
